results.name: more-itertools-tail
results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py by ensuring the start index for islice is non-negative when the requested tail length exceeds the iterable size. Changed `islice(iterable, size - n, None)` to `islice(iterable, max(size - n, 0), None)`. This resolves the ValueError when n > size.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the filesize.naturalsize function to use base 1000 for decimal mode (when neither binary nor gnu is True). The base was incorrectly set to 1024 for all cases, causing decimal conversions to use binary base. Changed line 91 to set base = 1024 if gnu or binary else 1000. All tests now pass.

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Fixed the ends_with and starts_with functions in jmespath/functions.py which were incorrectly swapped. The ends_with function was using str.startswith and starts_with was using str.endswith. Corrected them to use the appropriate string methods. Verified by running the compliance test suite for funct
